CCM.Name: 255 Rest
CCM.Memo: A rest. Removed when exporting to SMF. Use it to adjust the position of events.

CCM.Name: ** Control Change and more **
CCM.Memo: The basic events of an SMF (Standard MIDI File). (* Except the master volume.)

CCM.Name: 001 Modulation
CCM.Memo: Gives the sound a vibrato effect (modulates the pitch). * Functions can be added with CCM#353-358 Mod Control.

CCM.Name: 007 Volume
CCM.Memo: Volume of the part. Usually not used for changes while a note sounds. [Difference between Volume and Expression] Volume is absolute, Expression is relative. Think of Expression as a ratio of the Volume value.

CCM.Name: 010 Panpot
CCM.Memo: Pan position of the sound. Moves left or right around 64. * For a random pan, put CCM#395 Panpot in the "System Setup" track, after "-- CH Setup --".

CCM.Name: 011 Expression
CCM.Memo: Volume. Usually this is the one used for volume changes while a note sounds. [Difference between Volume and Expression] Volume is absolute, Expression is relative. Think of Expression as a ratio of the Volume value.

CCM.Name: 000 Bank MSB
CCM.Memo: [Bank Select MSB] Used to change the instrument. * In Domino, the "Gate" column of the Program Change can be used instead. * Held until a Program Change is received (CC#0 alone does not change the sound). * Sending order: "CC#0 Bank Select MSB → CC#32 Bank Select LSB → Program Change".

CCM.Name: 032 Bank LSB
CCM.Memo: [Bank Select LSB] Used to change the instrument. * In Domino, the "Gate" column of the Program Change can be used instead. * Held until a Program Change is received (CC#32 alone does not change the sound). * Sending order: "CC#0 Bank Select MSB → CC#32 Bank Select LSB → Program Change".

CCM.Name: 064 Hold Pedal
CCM.Memo: Ignores Note Off while it is ON. * Do not forget to set it back to OFF afterwards. * Precisely: "OFF: 0 to 63, ON: 64 to 127".

CCM.Name: 066 Sostenuto
CCM.Memo: Ignores Note Off only for the notes sounding at that moment. * Do not forget to set it back to OFF afterwards. * Precisely: "OFF: 0 to 63, ON: 64 to 127".

CCM.Name: 067 Soft Pedal
CCM.Memo: Softens the sound. * Do not forget to set it back to OFF afterwards. * Precisely: "OFF: 0 to 63, ON: 64 to 127".

CCM.Name: 091 Reverb
CCM.Memo: Amount of the reverb effect.

CCM.Name: 093 Chorus
CCM.Memo: Amount of the chorus effect.

CCM.Name: 094 Variation
CCM.Memo: Amount of the variation effect.

CCM.Name: 076 Vibrato Rate
CCM.Memo: Vibrato speed. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 077 Vibrato Depth
CCM.Memo: Vibrato depth. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 078 Vibrato Delay
CCM.Memo: Vibrato start time. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 074 Brightness (LPF Cutoff)
CCM.Memo: Brightness of the sound. The LPF (low-pass filter) Cutoff of the NRPN. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 071 Harmonic Content (Resonance)
CCM.Memo: Gives the sound more character. The Resonance of the NRPN. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 073 Attack Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Attack Time] Length of the attack of the sound. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 075 Decay Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Decay Time] Length of the decay of the sound. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 072 Release Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Release Time] Length of the tail after Note Off (after the end of the Gate Time). Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 016 AC1
CCM.Memo: [Assignable Controller 1] A CC with no effect assigned. Set its effect with CCM#378-383 AC1 Control.

CCM.Name: 017 AC2
CCM.Memo: [Assignable Controller 2] A CC with no effect assigned. Set its effect with CCM#385-390 AC2 Control.

CCM.Name: 065 Portamento
CCM.Memo: Makes the transitions between notes smooth. * On some modules, turning it ON in mono mode (CC#126 MONO) gives legato playing. * Precisely: "OFF: 0 to 63, ON: 64 to 127".

CCM.Name: 005 Portamento Time
CCM.Memo: Portamento speed (length of the pitch change).

CCM.Name: 084 Portamento Control
CCM.Memo: Key number (note) from which the portamento starts.

CCM.Name: 101 RPN MSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an RPN. Send in the order CC#101 → CC#100 → CC#6 (→ CC#38). CC#101 and CC#100 together select the function, CC#6 (and CC#38) set the amount.

CCM.Name: 100 RPN LSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an RPN. Send in the order CC#101 → CC#100 → CC#6 (→ CC#38). CC#101 and CC#100 together select the function, CC#6 (and CC#38) set the amount.

CCM.Name: 006 Data MSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an RPN or NRPN. - [RPN] Send in the order CC#101 → CC#100 → CC#6 (→ CC#38). CC#101 and CC#100 together select the function, CC#6 (and CC#38) set the amount. - [NRPN] Send in the order CC#99 → CC#98 → CC#6. CC#99 and CC#98 together select the function, CC#6 sets the amount.

CCM.Name: 038 Data LSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an RPN. Send in the order CC#101 → CC#100 → CC#6 → CC#38. CC#101 and CC#100 together select the function, CC#6 and CC#38 set the amount.

CCM.Name: 099 NRPN MSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an NRPN. Send in the order CC#99 → CC#98 → CC#6. CC#99 and CC#98 together select the function, CC#6 sets the amount.

CCM.Name: 098 NRPN LSB
CCM.Memo: Used to set an NRPN. Send in the order CC#99 → CC#98 → CC#6. CC#99 and CC#98 together select the function, CC#6 sets the amount. - [NRPN] 008 Vibrato Rate 009 Vibrato Depth 010 Vibrato Delay 032 LPF Cutoff Freq 033 Resonance 099 EG Attack Time 100 EG Decay Time 102 EG Release Time

CCM.Name: 120 All Sound Off
CCM.Memo: Stops the sounds currently playing.

CCM.Name: 121 Reset All Controller
CCM.Memo: Resets specific items. - [Reset] CC#001 Modulation CC#011 Expression CC#064 Hold Pedal CC#065 Partamento CC#066 Sostenuto CC#067 Soft Pedal CCM#128 Channel After Touch CCM#129 Polyphonic After Touch CCM#130 Pitch Bend - [Set back to unset] RPN NRPN

CCM.Name: 123 All Note Off
CCM.Memo: Performs a Note Off. * No effect while CC#64 Hold Pedal is ON.

CCM.Name: 126 MONO
CCM.Memo: Switches to mono mode, where chords cannot be played. * On some modules, turning CC#65 Portamento ON in mono mode gives legato playing. * Precisely: "ON: 0 to 16".

CCM.Name: 127 POLY
CCM.Memo: Allows chords to be played. Normally ON by default.

CCM.Name: 096 Data Increment
CCM.Memo: Adds 1 to the RPN value. Each one added increments the value again. (For example, five in a row give +5.)

CCM.Name: 097 Data Decrement
CCM.Memo: Subtracts 1 from the RPN value. Each one added decrements the value again. (For example, five in a row give -5.)

CCM.Name: 124 OMNI OFF
CCM.Memo: Same effect as CC#123 All Note Off, but this one should not be used.

CCM.Name: 125 OMNI ON
CCM.Memo: Same effect as CC#123 All Note Off, but this one should not be used.

Folder.Name: [128-131] CAT, PAT, Pitch Bend, Master Volume

CCM.Name: 128 CAT
CCM.Memo: [Channel After Touch] * Also called "Channel Pressure". A CC with no effect assigned. Set its effect with CCM#365-370 CAT Control.

CCM.Name: 129 PAT
CCM.Memo: [Polyphonic After Touch] * Also called "Polyphonic Key Pressure". A CC with no effect assigned. Set its effect with CCM#371-376 PAT Control. The effect applies only to the Note No. (note) given in Gate. * On XG modules the valid range of Gate is "36 to 97". * On XG modules it has no effect on drum parts.

CCM.Name: 130 Pitch Bend
CCM.Memo: Changes the pitch. The tone changes too, so it can also be used for sound design. Set the pitch range with RPN: Pitch Bend Sensitivity (CCM#151). * Functions can be added with CCM#359-364 PB Control.

CCM.Name: 131 Master Volume
CCM.Memo: [GM Master Volume] Overall volume. Mainly used for fade in and fade out.

CCM.Name: ** RPN, NRPN **
CCM.Memo: Parameters whose type is selected with "CC#101 + CC#100" or "CC#99 + CC#98" and whose value is set with "CC#6 (+ CC#38)". In Domino, these 3 or 4 events can be sent together with a single CCM.

CCM.Name: 150-155 RPN
CCM.Memo: Parameters whose type is selected with "CC#101 + CC#100" and whose value is set with "CC#6 (+ CC#38)". Apart from CCM#155 Modulation Depth Range, they work on all GM modules (or should).

CCM.Name: 151 Bend range
CCM.Memo: [Pitch Bend Sensitivity] * Also called "Pitch Bend Range" or "bend range". Sets, in semitones (12 is one octave), how much the pitch changes when CCM#130 Pitch Bend is at its maximum (+8191 or -8192). The default (after a reset) is normally 2. * Note that the range "0 to 48" is for MSGS only (GM modules normally use "0 to 24").

CCM.Name: 152 Fine tuning
CCM.Memo: [Master Fine Tuning] Fine-tunes the pitch of the part in units of 1/8192 of a semitone (+8191 raises it by a semitone). * A semitone is the next key (the next row of the piano roll), not "half of the next key". (For example, a semitone above C is C#, a semitone above E is F.)

CCM.Name: 153 GM Note shift
CCM.Memo: [Master Coarse Tuning] Adjusts the pitch of the part in semitones. Increases or decreases around 64. * Note that the notes are not moved: the pitch is shifted (so the tone changes too).

CCM.Name: 154 RPN Null
CCM.Memo: Cancels the RPN / NRPN selection, which disables CC#6 and CC#38. Prevents unwanted RPN / NRPN changes caused by a selection left active.

CCM.Name: 155 Mod Dep range
CCM.Memo: [Modulation Depth Range] Range of CC#1 Modulation.

CCM.Name: 156 GM Note shift (for sound design)
CCM.Memo: [Master Coarse Tuning] Adjusts the pitch of the part in semitones. CCM#153 GM Note shift with its value range changed to "-24 to 0 to +24". * For sound design with RPN: Master Coarse Tuning (using "Key correction" in the "Track properties"), this one is probably easier to use.

CCM.Name: 160-169 NRPN
CCM.Memo: Parameters whose type is selected with "CC#99 + CC#98" and whose value is set with "CC#6". * All of them can be replaced by a CC, so use the CC instead.

CCM.Name: 161 Vibrato Rate
CCM.Memo: Vibrato speed. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#76 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 162 Vibrato Depth
CCM.Memo: Vibrato depth. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#77 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 163 Vibrato Delay
CCM.Memo: Vibrato start time. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#78 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 164 LPF Cutoff
CCM.Memo: [LPF Cutoff Frequency] Brightness of the sound. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#74 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 165 Resonance
CCM.Memo: [LPF Resonance] Gives the sound more character. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#71 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 167 Attack Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Attack Time] Length of the attack of the sound. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#73 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 168 Decay Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Decay Time] Length of the decay of the sound. Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#75 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 169 Release Time
CCM.Memo: [EG Release Time] Length of the tail after Note Off (after the end of the Gate Time). Increases or decreases around 64. * CC#72 can be used instead.

CCM.Name: 180-192 Drum NRPN
CCM.Memo: Per-instrument drum parameters. "CC#99" selects the type of event, "CC#98" gives the Note No. of the instrument and "CC#6" sets the value. * They are reset when a Program Change is received, so put them after "-- CH Setup --".

CCM.Name: 181 Drum Pitch C
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Pitch Coarse] Sets the Pitch Coarse of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 182 Drum Pitch F
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Pitch Fine] Sets the Pitch Fine of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 183 Drum Level
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Level] Sets the Level (volume) of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. * A ratio of the drum part's CC#7 Volume.

CCM.Name: 184 Drum Panpot
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Panpot] Sets the pan position of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Moves left or right around 64. * "0" is random.

CCM.Name: 185 Drum Reverb
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Reverb] Sets the Reverb of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. * A ratio of the drum part's CC#91 Reverb.

CCM.Name: 186 Drum Chorus
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Chorus] Sets the Chorus of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. * A ratio of the drum part's CC#93 Chorus.

CCM.Name: 187 Drum Variation
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Variation] Sets the Variation of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. * A ratio of the drum part's CC#94 Variation. * When CCM#576 Variation Connect is "0: Insertion", switches the insertion effect ON/OFF per instrument: "0" is OFF, "1-127" is ON.

CCM.Name: 188 Drum LPF
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum LPF Cutoff Frequency] Sets the LPF Cutoff Frequency of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 189 Drum Resonance
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum LPF Resonance] Sets the LPF Cutoff Resonance of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 191 Drum Attack
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Attack Rate] Sets the Attack Rate of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 192 Drum Decay
CCM.Memo: [NRPN Drum Decay Rate] Sets both the Decay Rate and the Release Rate of the instrument whose Note No. is given in Gate. Increases or decreases around 64. * Decay Rate and Release Rate can only be set separately by exclusive (Drum x Parameter).

CCM.Name: ** Reset, extra drums, layers **
CCM.Memo: The basic set of 3 for GS and XG.

CCM.Name: 140-148 Reset
CCM.Memo: Initialization messages. They reset the parameters and prepare the module to use the corresponding sound map.

CCM.Name: 141 GS Reset
CCM.Memo: [GS Reset] The GS initialization message. XG modules switch to TG300B mode (GS mode).

CCM.Name: 142 System Mode Set
CCM.Memo: [System Mode Set] Used to switch modes on the SC-88 and SC-88Pro. Not used on the SC-8850, SC-8820 and SC-D70. * GS Reset does not cancel Double Module Mode, so for MIDI files meant for the SC-88 / SC-88Pro it may be better to put this before the GS Reset.

CCM.Name: 143 XG System On
CCM.Memo: [XG System On] The XG initialization message. * Required to use the sound map of XG modules.

CCM.Name: 145 XG Map Select
CCM.Memo: [Voice Map] Switches the GM map of XG modules. [MU basic] The older sounds of the MU50 era. [MU100Native] The newer sounds of the MU100 era. * No effect on the S-YXG50, but worth including for compatibility with MU100 and later hardware modules.

CCM.Name: 146 GM System On
CCM.Memo: [GM System On] The GM1 initialization message. Its purpose is to restrict functions rather than to reset, so do not use it unless that is intended.

CCM.Name: 147 GM2 System On
CCM.Memo: [GM2 System On] The GM2 initialization message. Often a source of needless trouble, so better not to use it.

CCM.Name: 148 GM System Off
CCM.Memo: [GM System Off] Initialization message of GM modules. Switches back to the native non-GM mode (GS or XG). Often a source of needless trouble, so better not to use it.

CCM.Name: 200-202 Extra Drum
CCM.Memo: Adds a drum part. Change it to "202 XG Extra drums" for XG modules or "201 GS Extra drums" for GS modules.

CCM.Name: 201 GS Extra drums
CCM.Memo: [Use For Rhythm Part] Used to add a drum part on GS modules. * This event works on MSGS and GS modules alike (including the TG300B mode of XG modules). * Some modules behave as if reset, so placing it before "-- CH Setup --" is recommended.

CCM.Name: 202 XG Extra drums
CCM.Memo: [Part Mode] Used to add a drum part on XG modules. * The S-YXG50 has no Drum3-4. Normally use "Drum2" (CH10 is already "Drum1"). * "Drum 0" has no per-instrument settings, but its Program Change can be changed per CH. * The drum parameters are reset, so placing it before "-- CH Setup --" is recommended.

CCM.Name: 210-214 Layer
CCM.Memo: Layers. Lets you save space by omitting identical performance data, or play a CH of another port.

CCM.Name: 212 GS Layer G → V
CCM.Memo: [Rx.Channel] Layers the CH given in Gate onto the CH given in Value. Layers let you save space by omitting identical performance data. * Cannot be used for MSGS (its Value numbering is offset).

CCM.Name: 214 XG Layer G → V
CCM.Memo: [Receive Channel] Layers the CH given in Gate onto the CH given in Value. Layers let you save space by omitting identical performance data. They can also play a CH of another port.

CCM.Name: ** Memo **
CCM.Memo: Dummy data for notes. Removed when exporting to SMF.

CCM.Name: * [Important] About adding drums
CCM.Memo: Extra drum parts are set in the "System Setup" track. See the description of "200-202 Extra Drum" in the "System Setup" track.

CCM.Name: * About this space
CCM.Memo: To use several ports with a MIDI player that only accepts one, such as YAMAHA MidRadio Player, put "214 XG Layer G → V" at this position. This space is reserved for that, so it can normally be ignored. For details, see the original author's MIDI transcription course (in Japanese).

CCM.Name: ** XG Other **
CCM.Memo: Exclusive messages specific to XG modules.

CCM.Name: 300-315 Global settings
CCM.Memo: Settings that affect the whole module.

CCM.Name: 300 All Parameter Reset
CCM.Memo: [All Parameter Reset] Used to reset the parameters that XG System On does not reset (mainly the settings of the unit itself). * "Test send" is recommended when using it. (The unit's settings belong to each user and should not be forced on others by leaving this in the MIDI data.)

CCM.Name: 301 XG Master Volume
CCM.Memo: [Master Volume] Overall volume. Linked with CCM#131 GM Master Volume, so CCM#131 is normally used instead.

CCM.Name: 303 Master Tune
CCM.Memo: [Master Tune] Overall tuning. Set within -102.4 to +102.3 cents.

CCM.Name: 304 Transpose
CCM.Memo: [Transpose] Overall note shift. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 305 Mute Lock
CCM.Memo: [Mute Lock] Whether the Mute state of the unit is locked. * "Test send" is recommended when using it. (The unit's settings belong to each user and should not be forced on others by leaving this in the MIDI data.)

CCM.Name: 308 Rcv System On Message
CCM.Memo: [Rcv System On Message] Whether resets are received. Set to OFF to ignore them.

CCM.Name: 309 Rcv Bank Select
CCM.Memo: [Rcv Bank Select] Whether Bank Select is received. Set to OFF to ignore it.

CCM.Name: 311 Dump Interval Time
CCM.Memo: [Bulk Out Interval Time] ?

CCM.Name: 312 PS Channel
CCM.Memo: [Performance System Channel] ?

CCM.Name: 313 PS Trancepose
CCM.Memo: [Performance System Trancepose] ?

CCM.Name: 314 LCD Contrast
CCM.Memo: [LCD Contrast] Brightness of the unit's panel.

CCM.Name: 315 MIDI OUT Port No.
CCM.Memo: [Thru Port (Multi Port Number for MIDI OUT)] ?

CCM.Name: 318-329 Scale tuning
CCM.Memo: Fine-tunes the pitch of each note of the scale.

CCM.Name: 318 Scale tuning C
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning C] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 319 Scale tuning C#
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning C#] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 320 Scale tuning D
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning D] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 321 Scale tuning D#
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning D#] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 322 Scale tuning E
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning E] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 323 Scale tuning F
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning F] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 324 Scale tuning F#
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning F#] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 325 Scale tuning G
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning G] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 326 Scale tuning G#
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning G#] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 327 Scale tuning A
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning A] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 328 Scale tuning A#
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning A#] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 329 Scale tuning B
CCM.Memo: [Scale Tuning B] Tuning in cents. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 330-346 Disable
CCM.Memo: Disables individual events. For example, with layers, lets you apply Pitch Bend to only one of the CHs.

CCM.Name: 330 Rcv Note Message
CCM.Memo: [Receive Note Message] OFF ignores notes.

CCM.Name: 331 Rcv Program Change
CCM.Memo: [Receive Program Change] OFF ignores Program Change.

CCM.Name: 332 Rcv Bank Select
CCM.Memo: [Receive Bank Select] OFF ignores CC#0 and 32.

CCM.Name: 333 Rcv Modulation
CCM.Memo: [Receive Modulation] OFF ignores CC#1 Modulation.

CCM.Name: 334 Rcv Volume
CCM.Memo: [Receive Volume] OFF ignores CC#7 Volume.

CCM.Name: 335 Rcv Panpot
CCM.Memo: [Receive Pan] OFF ignores CC#10 Panpot.

CCM.Name: 336 Rcv Expression
CCM.Memo: [Receive Expression] OFF ignores CC#11 Expression.

CCM.Name: 337 Rcv RPN
CCM.Memo: [Receive RPN] OFF ignores RPN.

CCM.Name: 338 Rcv NRPN
CCM.Memo: [Receive NRPN] OFF ignores NRPN.

CCM.Name: 339 Rcv Control Change
CCM.Memo: [Receive Control Change] OFF ignores CC#0 to 127.

CCM.Name: 340 Rcv Pitch Bend
CCM.Memo: [Receive Pitch Bend] OFF ignores CCM#130 Pitch Bend.

CCM.Name: 341 Rcv CAT
CCM.Memo: [Receive CH After Touch] OFF ignores CCM#128 CAT.

CCM.Name: 342 Rcv PAT
CCM.Memo: [Receive Poly After Touch] OFF ignores CCM#129 PAT.

CCM.Name: 343 Rcv Hold Pedal
CCM.Memo: [Receive Hold Pedal] OFF ignores CC#64 Hold Pedal.

CCM.Name: 344 Rcv Sostenuto
CCM.Memo: [Receive Sostenuto] OFF ignores CC#66 Sostenuto.

CCM.Name: 345 Rcv Soft Pedal
CCM.Memo: [Receive Soft Pedal] OFF ignores CC#67 Soft Pedal.

CCM.Name: 346 Rcv Portamento
CCM.Memo: [Receive Portamento] OFF ignores CC#65 Portamento.

CCM.Name: 347-352 Pitch EG + Velocity Sense
CCM.Memo: [Pitch EG] Sets the pitch change at the start and at the end of a note. Used for example to reproduce the rise of a wind instrument. [Velocity Sense] Sets the volume reference and the volume differences given by the Velocity.

CCM.Name: 347 PEG InitLev
CCM.Memo: [Pitch EG Initial Level] Positive values start the note at a higher pitch than normal, negative values at a lower pitch. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 348 PEG Attack
CCM.Memo: [Pitch EG Attack Time] Sets the time taken to go from the pitch of CCM#347 Pitch EG Initial Level back to the normal pitch. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 349 PEG Rel Lev
CCM.Memo: [Pitch EG Release Level] Positive values end the note at a higher pitch than normal, negative values at a lower pitch. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 350 PEG RelTime
CCM.Memo: [Pitch EG Release Time] Sets the time taken to go from the normal pitch to the pitch of CCM#349 Pitch EG Release Level. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 351 Velocity Depth
CCM.Memo: [Velocity Sense Depth] Volume differences given by the Velocity.

CCM.Name: 352 Velocity Offset
CCM.Memo: [Velocity Sense Offset] Volume reference of the Velocity.

CCM.Name: 353-358 Mod Control
CCM.Memo: Sets the effect of CC#1 Modulation. The amount of change and the modulation depth of "pitch, tone, volume" can be set. For example, with layers, lets you modulate the pitch of only one of the CHs.

CCM.Name: 353 Mod Pitch range
CCM.Memo: [MW Pitch Control] Sets the pitch range in semitones. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 354 Mod LPF CutF
CCM.Memo: [MW LPF Control] Amount of LPF Cutoff change. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 355 Mod Volume
CCM.Memo: [MW Amplitude Control] Amount of volume change. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 356 Mod Pitch Mod
CCM.Memo: [MW LFO PMod Depth] Depth of the pitch modulation.

CCM.Name: 357 Mod LPF Mod
CCM.Memo: [MW LFO FMod Depth] Depth of the tone modulation.

CCM.Name: 358 Mod Vol Mod
CCM.Memo: [MW LFO AMod Depth] Depth of the volume modulation.

CCM.Name: 359-364 PB Control
CCM.Memo: Sets the effect of CCM#130 Pitch Bend. The amount of change and the modulation depth of "pitch, tone, volume" can be set. For example, with layers, lets you change the pitch of only one of the CHs.

CCM.Name: 359 PB Pitch range
CCM.Memo: [Bend Pitch Control] Sets the pitch range in semitones. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 360 PB LPF CutF
CCM.Memo: [Bend LPF Control] Amount of LPF Cutoff change. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 361 PB Volume
CCM.Memo: [Bend Amplitude Control] Amount of volume change. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 362 PB Pitch Mod
CCM.Memo: [Bend LFO PMod Depth] Depth of the pitch modulation.

CCM.Name: 363 PB LPF Mod
CCM.Memo: [Bend LFO FMod Depth] Depth of the tone modulation.

CCM.Name: 364 PB Vol Mod
CCM.Memo: [Bend LFO AMod Depth] Depth of the volume modulation.

CCM.Name: 365-370 CAT Control
CCM.Memo: Sets the effect of CCM#128 CAT. The amount of change and the modulation depth of "pitch, tone, volume" can be set. For example, with layers, lets you modulate the volume of only one of the CHs.

CCM.Name: 365 CAT Pitch range
CCM.Memo: [CAT Pitch Control] Sets the pitch range in semitones. Increases or decreases around 64.

CCM.Name: 366 CAT LPF CutF
